findings.summary: The same logo image markup is duplicated across both navigation branches.
findings.consequence: A future change to the logo source, class, or accessible text can update one branch but not the other, making the hydrated NuxtLink and native fallback diverge.
findings.evidence: Line 13 renders the same `img` as line 16; the only intended branch difference is the wrapper element and navigation mode.
findings.recommendation: Keep the branch only around the wrapper behavior, but factor the repeated image into a tiny local logo component/slot or otherwise render the image from one shared template path so both modes stay identical.
